summary: Tested the v2 change request end to end in SIMULATION mode; live mode was never toggled and test-vapi was never called. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (tests/test_rpi_v2.py). These cover settings validation (duplicate state rule, invalid language, opening without {{agent_name}}, voice-profile count), agent_name required (422), all 3 scripts containing the agent name, CSV 4-column validation (Missing phone_number / Missing bank_name / header errors / import 400), West Bengal case-insensitive -> bn-IN and others -> hi-IN, a state rule changed after import applied at dial time (Maharashtra -> en-IN), simulation completing with the 8 canonical dispositions, export with exactly the 14 columns plus JSON transcript plus the 'Final Denial Closing' filter, recordings 404, retry unreached / selected retry excluding RPC, and webhook tool-calls(file_disposition HOSTILE) -> end-of-call-report giving disposition HOSTILE with classification.source 'agent' and Recording link https://<base>/api/recordings/<attempt_id>. Frontend: Settings page (3 voice rows, edits persist after save + reload, state rule add/edit/delete, duplicate-rule error toast, fallback Hindi, 8 disposition rows, Bengali script tab, emotion textarea, no company field), create-campaign dialog (agent name required), script panel showing the agent in en/bn/hi, CSV dialog (header errors, invalid table with per-row errors, import 4 of 6), launch -> KPI grid with 10 cards and correct slug testids, disposition filter tabs incl. Final_Denial_Closing, filtered export download, call drawer (status, category, LLM summary, classifier reasoning, Bengali transcript), Retry unreached toast, and campaign-bucket-counts on the list. All passed. Settings were restored to defaults and TEST_ data was removed.

minor.issue: The greedy regex r'\{.*\}' + json.loads fails with 'Extra data' when the LLM reply contains trailing text or braces (seen once in backend.err.log). It then silently falls back to keyword rules. Fix: use json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode starting at the first '{'.

The agent's file_disposition is ignored whenever call_status != 'completed' (e.g. a live call where no customer turns were parsed, or an endedReason containing the broad FAILED_MARKERS 'number'/'error'). Such calls are forced to unreached_disposition. Consider trusting agent_disposition when the agent actually filed one.
A tool call with an unknown function name returns 'Invalid disposition' instead of an unknown-tool message (cosmetic).

issues: At 1920px the table is clipped on the right (STT language column cut off); voice-ID inputs are truncated at about 110px.
The description says 'CRTC-style' (a Canadian regulator), which does not fit this India-focused product; it should say TRAI/DND.

The downloaded filename contains spaces when the filter is 'Final Denial Closing' (rpi_<name>_Final Denial Closing.csv); the backend already replaces spaces with underscores but the frontend overrides a.download.
The 'RevLoop' brand is still shown in the sidebar and FastAPI title. It is not the agent name (that part is correctly configurable), but confirm the brand is intended.

action_items: Make llm_classify JSON extraction robust (raw_decode / non-greedy parse) so a slightly malformed LLM reply does not drop to keyword rules
Optional: honour agent_disposition in classify_call even when call_status is not 'completed' for live calls
Optional: fix voice-profiles table overflow, the 'CRTC-style' copy and the export filename spaces
critical_code_review_comments: /api/recordings proxies any stored recording_url (SSRF surface if the webhook token leaks); consider restricting to the Vapi/storage host allowlist
pytest.ini enforces '-n auto'; test_rpi_v2.py mutates global settings, so run it with '-n 0' (a parallel run caused a state-rule race)
In the export, the 'Call Status' column holds the contact status (pending/queued) for never-dialed rows; acceptable, but document it
seed_data_creation: TEST_ campaigns/contacts/attempts (including one fake live attempt with provider_call_id test-xyz-*) were created and then deleted. Settings were restored (state rules [West Bengal->bn-IN], fallback hi-IN, default emotion, stt nova-3, call_mode simulation).
test_credentials: No auth; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (expected). Webhook token is read from mongo settings.
playbook_testing: There is no 'Jev' route in this app (grep found none), so the playbook check is N/A.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_rpi_v2.py -n 0. NEVER switch call_mode to live (a real Vapi key is saved). The old tests/test_rpi_api.py is obsolete (v1 dispositions). Simulated outcomes are random; LLM (claude-sonnet-4-5) classification works, about 5-8s per call.
